text_block_list.text: One day, Кинг Хало receives a fan letter.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, a fan letter? I guess I'll hold onto it.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Let's start the meeting. That's what we're
here for,
anyway.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I got a fan letter! A letter all for
me!
Hehehe! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for this for so long!
Let's see
what it says! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Hey, King. Wow, don't you look happy!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Huh?! U-Urara, when did you get back?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Just a second ago! Hey, who's the letter
from?
Lemme see!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
But why? C'mon, let me see it!
Pleeeeease!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times you ask, the
answer
will still be no!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
A fan used their precious time to write
this letter
to me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It's only proper that I handle it with
utmost
respect...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
After all, it is a treasure meant only for
my eyes.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Hmm, I guess that makes sense!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but I guess I kinda

understand! It's a really important letter,
right?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm glad you understand anyway.
Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
